summary: Feed s180_triple to IDS is degraded: 3 faults found. Bursts to 3.07 Gbps overload the 1 Gbps IDS port (307% capacity) causing 4.9% TCP packet loss, plus 72.8% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS 60% tolerance, blinding payload inspection.

findings.root_cause: Peak bursts of 3.07 Gbps in 1ms intervals exceed the IDS 1 Gbps port capacity by 307% (threshold 80%). Packet broker is forwarding full aggregate to a single tool port without load-balancing, aggregation control, or burst buffering, so the egress queue overruns.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS drops packets during bursts, misses signatures and flow reassembly, creates intermittent blind spots; detection coverage severely degraded at peak times despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across multiple IDS instances or add capacity with flow-aware hashing so no single 1G port exceeds 80%; preserves full payload and bidirectional flows required by IDS while absorbing bursts.

findings.root_cause: 4.9% of TCP packets (106/2174) show gaps/retransmissions indicating capture loss upstream of IDS. Consistent with SPAN/mirror buffer overflow and broker egress drops when overloaded by 3+ Gbps bursts to a 1G port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS receives incomplete TCP streams, fails to reassemble payloads and track state, misses exploits and generates false negatives; violates needs_full_payload requirement.

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, line-rate copy unlike SPAN which drops under load; combined with fixing overload, eliminates the 4.9% gaps and ensures complete, correct packets reach IDS.

findings.root_cause: 72.8% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) vs IDS tolerance of 60%. Traffic mix has shifted to mostly TLS 1.3/encrypted services without corresponding decryption before the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs_full_payload but cannot inspect encrypted payloads; signatures do not fire and detection falls back to metadata only, reducing coverage for this IDS.

recommended_fix.why: Centralized selective decryption restores payload visibility for IDS inspection; if decryption not allowed, tune IDS to metadata/analytics and accept reduced detection on encrypted flows.
